messages:
alex: Heads-up — the payments canary in eu-west is flapping. Observed service restarts + liveness failures for the sidecar after the chart bumped to v2.14 earlier today. Any objections to pinning chart to v2.13 and rolling back the canary?

deploy-bot: Canary health check failed for release=payments, namespace=payments-eu, canary_fraction=10%. 3/10 pods failing liveness probes. See: https://deploys.redwood.ai/canaries/1694320998 :rotating_light:

maria: :eyes: I saw the same. Looks like the sidecar probe path changed in the new chart: `/healthz/live` -> `/internal/health`. Our values override didn't include the new probe path.

sam: We could either patch values to keep old probe path or pin chart to v2.13 then promote the patched chart later. Patching values is fastest.

ryan: If we patch values, can we do a canary hotfix (image + values) and re-run canary? I don't want to revert the whole chart if there are other unrelated fixes in 2.14.

alex: Good point. Are there other important fixes in 2.14 that we'd lose by pinning?

maria: 2.14 has a couple perf tweaks for KV cache and a CRD minor change. Not critical for payments immediate path. I prefer a values patch for the probe path so we don't lose perf fixes.

sam: Ok quick plan: create a kustomize patch or helm values override to set the sidecar liveness to `/healthz/live` and re-run canary. If that stabilizes, we can merge a follow-up values reconcile to account for the new probe path when we update the app sidecar.

alex: Can someone post the exact helm values snippet?

sam: Sure — testing locally then will post.

sam: ```yaml
sidecar:
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz/live
      port: 8081
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
```

maria: I patched a canary override in the release branch and kicked a redeploy. deploy-bot should pick it up.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: payments-canary-override by maria. Chart: payments-chart@v2.14 (overrides applied). Canary scheduled: 10% of traffic for 15m. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/logs/1694321022

oncall-bot: FYI — this rollout overlaps next infra window at 23:00 UTC. If canary fails again we should either abort or pin before the window.

ryan: If it fails again, I'm leaning to pin to v2.13 + doc the perf fixes we postpone. That gives us time to coordinate the sidecar update across services.

alex: Agree. Also need a short release note entry for the rollback/pin or the override. Whoever does the pin, add a note like: "Payments: temporary probe override to restore canary; chart pinned to v2.13 pending sidecar compatibility fix (see issue #2345)."

maria: Will add to release notes and create issue #2345 for the sidecar migration.

sam: Canary looks stable after patch, 15/15 successful health checks in the last 5m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary health check passed; promoting canary to 50% for gradual rollout.

alex: Nice. Keep the pin plan as backup. If anything degrades during the next 30m we'll pin and open the rollback playbook.

ryan: Also add a blurb in the changelog about the probe path change so infra and platform teams can coordinate updates to other charts that embed the sidecar.

maria: Added release note and flagged platform channel. 

alex: Closing this thread once the rollout hits 100% or we pin. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: payments service rolled to 100% traffic. Release notes updated at https://releases.redwood.ai/notes/1694321000

alex: Closing — marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
